content.short: TRM Labs provides blockchain intelligence for compliance, sanctions screening and risk management.
content.description: TRM Labs provides blockchain intelligence for compliance, investigations and supervision, packaged as its Compliance360, Investigation360 and Supervision360 products. Wallet screening and the BLOCKINT API let institutions check addresses against its threat intelligence before transacting. Law enforcement agencies have used its tooling in asset forfeiture cases, including a 15 million dollar action against a fentanyl vendor. Both Monad and Robinhood Chain are covered, and a chain carrying tokenized equities needs this layer present from day one.
content.meta: Transaction monitoring and sanctions screening used by regulated institutions and agencies.
